training_frequency: every two years thereafter if still employed, within six months of employment initially
required_topics: definition of human trafficking and commercial exploitation of children
guidance on identifying individuals most at risk for human trafficking
difference between labor and sex trafficking as it relates to lodging establishments, restaurants, and truck stops
role of employees in reporting and responding to human trafficking
harbor_alliance_actions: Develop a curriculum for approved programs
risks_or_constraints: Employers must provide training on recognizing human trafficking and reporting it, or face civil penalties of up to $1,500 per offense if violations are discovered
